scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/evidence packages/model-driver packages/tool-broker packages/kernel apps/cli
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/contracts packages/evidence packages/model-driver packages/tool-broker packages/kernel apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false packages/contracts packages/evidence packages/model-driver packages/tool-broker packages/kernel apps/cli && tsc -p packages/model-driver/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/tool-broker/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false
